events.title: Sports Club
events.description: A sports club description outlines the organization’s mission, physical activities, and community goals. It typically highlights skill-building, teamwork, physical fitness, competitive events, and social inclusion to attract members and promote holistic well-being.

A GenAI club helps students and professionals master generative artificial intelligence through hands-on learning. Core activities include building AI agents, analyzing datasets, prompting image/text models, competing in hackathons, and exploring the ethical considerations of Large Language Models.
events.title: Genai Club
AI RoboDog: Vision & Motion Control
events.description:
This workshop is designed to introduce students to the fascinating world of intelligent robotic systems that mimic animal-like movement and behavior. Participants will explore how advanced robotics and artificial intelligence work together to create machines that can move, react, and interact with their environment in real time.
The session will cover the fundamentals of robotic motion, including how robotic gaits are designed to replicate natural movement patterns. Students will also discover how robots perceive their surroundings using vision systems and sensors, enabling them to make decisions and respond dynamically to obstacles and environmental changes.
In addition, the workshop introduces key concepts behind mapping and autonomous navigation—the same core technologies used in self-driving vehicles, industrial automation, and modern intelligent robots. Through live demonstrations and interactive explanations, participants will gain insights into how motion control, perception, and AI combine to power agile and responsive robotic systems.
This session offers an engaging introduction to next-generation robotics, helping students understand the technologies shaping the future of intelligent machines.

An Arts Club is a vibrant community designed to foster creativity, self-expression, and collaboration. It serves as an inclusive platform for members to explore mediums like visual arts, music, dance, and theater, while building leadership skills and personal well-being through workshops, and cultural events.
events.title: Arts Club
Media Club Activities
events.description: A Media Club is a student-run organization that serves as a creative outlet for students to express themselves and develop skills in mass media, digital communication, and journalism. Members collaborate to produce content such as short films, photography, podcasts, blogs, and social media campaigns while exploring the impact of media on society.

events.title: Enterpreneur club
events.description: An entrepreneur club (or E-club) is a dynamic community dedicated to fostering innovation, business leadership, and startup culture. These organizations bridge the gap between theory and practice by providing resources, mentorship, and networking opportunities to help aspiring founders turn early ideas into scalable, profitable businesses.

events.title: 🎬 Reel Re-Creation Challenge
events.description:
dea:

Each team will choose a social media reel and recreate it live on stage. It can be funny, emotional, cinematic, or trending anything that can be performed in front of an audience.

Guidelines:

- One reel per team.
- Performance should be at least 60-90 seconds long.
- Try to match the original reel's expressions, dialogues, timing, and overall vibe.
- You're free to add your own creative touch.
- Props, costumes, background music, and sound effects can be used if needed.

Why this activity?

It's a fun and simple activity that encourages creativity, teamwork, and confidence on stage while giving everyone a chance to recreate their favorite reels in their own style.

Virtual Paint is an AI and Computer Vision application enabling digital drawing via hand gestures.
It captures webcam feed to track hand landmarks and the index finger in real time.
The movement of the fingertip translates into smooth lines on a merged live canvas.
Features include brush size adjustments, color options, an eraser, and saving capability.
